content: On Wikipedia, we observe that the performance of biLSTM, Inception, and Joint is much better than that of all four baselines. Inception achieves 2.9% higher accuracy than biLSTM. The performance of Joint achieves an accuracy of 59.4%, which is 5.3% higher than using textual features alone (biLSTM) and 2.4% higher than using visual features alone (Inception). Based on a one-tailed Wilcoxon signed-rank test, the performance of Joint is statistically significant ( $p<0.05$ ). This shows that the textual and visual features complement each other, achieving state-of-the-art results in combination.
